newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Qatari foreign minister to visit PLO-ruled Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Qatari foreign minister to visit PLO-ruled Gaza.

text.p: Qatar's foreign minister will visit the Palestinian-ruled Gaza Strip on Monday for talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, Arafat's office said on Sunday.
Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim al-Thani will be the highest ranking Qatari official to go to Gaza since the enclave was handed over to Palestinian self-rule in 1994 under a peace deal with Israel.

No plans were announced for Hamad to meet Israeli officials. The Qatari minister told Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy at a Middle East economic conference in Cairo last week that the tiny Gulf nation was freezing normalisation with Israel.
Israel has a trade mission in the Qatari capital of Doha but Qatar has delayed opening a reciprocal trade mission until the Jewish state moves ahead in peace talks with the Palestinians.
